name: GRANBELL HOTEL SUSUKINO
detail: This hotel has a clean feel, and the staff is polite, leading to a high level of satisfaction with the price. The location is good, making it convenient for sightseeing and food tasting. The room is a bit small, and the bathroom is just a shower room, but I was satisfied with the large public bath on the top floor, which was nice.

name: JR Inn Sapporo
detail: The location is great, just a 5-minute walk from Sapporo Station, and it's easy to find. The cleanliness of the accommodation, the attitude of the staff, soundproofing, water pressure, and facilities were all good. However, there is a subway track in front of the hotel, so it can be quite noisy and you can feel vibrations during operating hours. It might be difficult for light sleepers. The complimentary breakfast was also great, as they made sure nothing was missing.

name: GARDENS CABIN
detail: I made a reservation for my last day of travel. The reviews were good, and I chose a cabin because I didn’t want to deal with finding a place for my large suitcase for a week. I opted for breakfast since drinks are available but food isn’t. The menu had fewer options than I expected. It was great that there were soup curry and fish typical of Sapporo. I was looking forward to enjoying the large public bath, but the water was lukewarm, which was disappointing since I wanted a hot bath. I think it’s nice to go early as it was less crowded then. The cabin had accordion curtains, and it was nice to watch TV with headphones available for loan. However, I was bothered by the noise from the cheaper lodging in the vertical hole; it was so disruptive that I felt like it was almost all night. I thought they might as well have booked a regular hotel if they were going to be that noisy, and I fell asleep thinking about that. In the morning, I woke up around 5:00 and it was a good decision to start my day early, allowing me to wash my face leisurely. I could take my time doing my makeup after returning to the cabin, and it was great that I could focus on washing my face and brushing my teeth in peace. A few hours later, it was all packed, and the young guests were getting ready properly, but I noticed that even when the hairdryer’s cord was in the sink, they just left it as is. The outlets were built-in, but since it’s near water, it seemed dangerous. I thought it would be reassuring if the staff checked regularly. Since it’s a capsule hotel, it’s unavoidable, but my impression was that there were quite a few people without manners. The staff, especially the males, seemed more polite. I had too high expectations due to the overly positive comments, so next time, I’ll book a cabin without breakfast. It’s perfect just to stay and store my suitcase! On the way back, I walked through the underground for about 15 minutes and came out near Sapporo Station. It was convenient to go underground from the building right next to it!

name: Granbell hotel Tanuki, Sapporo
detail: I'm a repeat visitor. This hotel is really great. It's clean, and the location of the large public bath is excellent! The shampoo, treatment, and body soap have an outstanding sense of quality. The shower room in the guest room is also independent and stylish... The location is top-notch. There's a convenience store next door, and everything in Tanuki Koji is within walking distance. I definitely recommend it. Since I didn't have meals included this time, I would like to stay with meals next time.

name: HELIO HOSTEL SAPPORO
detail: I used it for a 2-night, 3-day stay due to some business. It was my first time using it, and overall it was clean and comfortable. Pros: - Cheap prices. - There is a café and lobby on the first floor where you can relax after checkout. - Amenities are well-stocked. - Conveniently located near a convenience store and Tanukikoji shopping street. - The staff are kind. - There is a women-only shower room. - It is quiet while sleeping. → I think it is perfectly comfortable for those who just want a place to sleep! Cons: - You can't eat food in the sleeping area, so you have to move to the space on the first or fifth floor (drinks are allowed). - It is quite difficult to place a suitcase on the upper bunk of the bunk bed (the ladder is attached and hard to climb). - The bed lighting uses an orange bulb, which made it personally difficult to apply makeup. The cons are minimal, and overall it was a hotel I would like to use again.

name: REGIONIA by Quintessa Sapporo Sta. Front
detail: We stayed for three consecutive nights on a family trip to Hokkaido. The facilities were kept clean, and the staff were friendly. It is located between Sapporo Station and Odori Park, so the location is great. Although the room was a bit cramped for four adults, we were satisfied considering the price.

name: The Centurion Sauna Rest & Stay Sapporo Male Only
detail: I've been to about 10 capsule hotels so far, and I had no idea there could be such quality in the city. The staff were friendly, and the location was just 5 minutes from Susukino Station. There were plenty of amenities inside, and the restaurant was quite large. The bath was nice, and I've never seen a place with hair loss treatment products in the bath before, haha. Additionally, for those with achy bodies, there's a gym on the 3rd floor where you can do some weight training with dumbbells (there are no machines). Overall, the facilities were excellent, and the inside of the capsule had gold-colored wallpaper, which seemed to bring good fortune. The mattress and pillow were also very comfortable. I used it for just under 20,000 yen, which I felt was a very reasonable price (the accommodation tax of 300 yen charged on-site was a bit annoying, but since it's tax, there's nothing you can do about it, unfortunately).

name: Hotel Resol Trinity Sapporo
detail: The bus stop for the direct bus to New Chitose Airport is right in front, making it very convenient. If you stay, I recommend the Park View rooms. They are a bit more expensive, but the level of satisfaction changes dramatically. The interior is always clean, with detailed cleaning done, and on the first floor, there is a free coffee maker, ice in the large public bath, bottled water in the room, coffee packs, and everything needed for a stay is provided. The large public bath on the top floor is also wonderful. Additionally, the bed mattress and pillows are very good, allowing for a deep sleep. It's very convenient with good access to anywhere, and the staff are all very kind; I truly had a satisfying 5-night stay. When I stay in Sapporo, I will definitely come here again.

name: Hotel Plus Hostel SAPPORO
detail: 1️⃣ Convenient transportation. It's just a 2-minute walk to the bus station for New Chitose Airport; a 6-minute walk to the Namboku Line Odori Station. 2️⃣ Convenient shopping. Various stores like Daikoku Drugstore, Don Quijote, capsule toy shops, and Soup Curry SAMA are right downstairs. 3️⃣ The water pressure in the shower is strong and warm, not cold at all. 4️⃣ The front desk provides breakfast coupons, and the service is very friendly. 5️⃣ Good soundproofing. Stayed for 6 nights and barely heard any noise, sleep was comfortable.

name: KOKO HOTEL Sapporo Ekimae
detail: It was very convenient to access both Sapporo Station and Odori Station. The room was also clean. The hot water was good, and the washroom was easy to use. Breakfast at Capricciosa in the building was delicious no matter what I ate.
